from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('Vero_Refine_ArchAcc_R.thy');s=p.read_text();body=re.search(r'\\(\\* VERO START c0007 prove \\*\\)(.*?)\\(\\* VERO END c0007 prove \\*\\)',s,re.S)[1].replace('  assume eq: \"p = p\\'\"\\n','').replace('using eq abs con rel get aget','using abs con rel get aget')
a=body.index('  have con:');b=body.index('  have rel:');con=r'''  have con: \"\\<And>s s' ep. \\<lbrakk>(s,s') \\<in> state_relation; kheap s p = Some (ArchObj (ARM_A.ASIDPool ep)); pspace_aligned' s'; pspace_distinct' s'\\<rbrakk> \\<Longrightarrow> \\<exists>ep'. ksPSpace s' p = Some (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep')) \\<and> is_aligned p (objBitsKO (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep'))) \\<and> ps_clear p (objBitsKO (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep'))) s'\"
  proof -
    fix s s' ep
    assume sr: \"(s,s') \\<in> state_relation\" and kh: \"kheap s p = Some (ArchObj (ARM_A.ASIDPool ep))\" and al: \"pspace_aligned' s'\" and di: \"pspace_distinct' s'\"
    have ps: \"pspace_relation (kheap s) (ksPSpace s')\" using sr by (simp add: state_relation_def)
    have d: \"p \\<in> dom (ksPSpace s')\"
      using ps kh by (auto simp: pspace_relation_def pspace_dom_def dom_def)
    obtain ko where ko: \"ksPSpace s' p = Some ko\" using d by auto
    have rr: \"\\<forall>x\\<in>dom (kheap s). \\<forall>(y,P)\\<in>obj_relation_cuts (the (kheap s x)) x. P (the (kheap s x)) (the (ksPSpace s' y))\"
      using ps by (simp add: pspace_relation_def)
    have r: \"other_obj_relation (ArchObj (ARM_A.ASIDPool ep)) ko\"
      using rr[rule_format, of p \"(p,other_obj_relation)\"] kh ko by (auto simp: dom_def)
    have k: \"\\<exists>ep'. ko = KOArch (KOASIDPool ep')\"
      using r
      apply (cases ko; simp add: other_obj_relation_def)
      subgoal for ao by (cases ao; auto)
      done
    show \"\\<exists>ep'. ksPSpace s' p = Some (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep')) \\<and> is_aligned p (objBitsKO (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep'))) \\<and> ps_clear p (objBitsKO (KOArch (KOASIDPool ep'))) s'\"
      using k ko al di d by (auto simp: pspace_aligned'_def pspace_distinct'_def)
  qed
''';body=body[:a]+con+body[b:];s=re.sub(r'(\\(\\* VERO START c0006 prove \\*\\)).*?(\\(\\* VERO END c0006 prove \\*\\))',lambda m:m[1]+body+m[2],s,flags=re.S);p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 /backend/tool.py check Vero_Refine_ArchAcc_R"
